newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita says has no reason to issue shares.
newsitem.headline: Merita says has no reason to issue shares.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy has no reason to raise capital by issuing shares, and has no share issue project going on, Merita spokesman Timo Nikinmaa told Reuters on Wednesday.
He was commenting on a stock market rumour that the bank would be issuing shares, which some brokers said was lifting it by almost seven percent to new life highs at 23.50 markka.
"There are no such things that would make a share issue topical," he said. "The corridors here are totally empty, so certainly nothing is going on," he added.
